name: Django: Deploy
description: Update a Django project on the server: git pull, install requirements (online or offline), check, migrate, collectstatic and restart the service. Stops at the first failing step.

parameters.name: branch
parameters.label: Branch
parameters.help: Optional. Fetch and switch to this branch before pulling.

parameters.name: requirements
parameters.label: Requirements file
parameters.help: Relative to the project directory, or a full path.

parameters.name: wheelhouse
parameters.label: Offline wheelhouse
parameters.help: Optional. If set, packages are installed from this folder with no internet.

parameters.name: service
parameters.label: systemd service to restart
parameters.help: Optional. Needs root or passwordless sudo on the server.
